name: Phoenix Eternal Liquidation Cascade - BTC
description: Stresses one Phoenix Eternal Trader's collateral, then shocks the BTC mark price a slot later, so the trader crosses into liquidation territory while the run is live. Replace the trader pubkey with an account that exists on your fork; collateral can only be lowered, since an override cannot mint the vault backing it. Both values are decimal strings because they span the full i64/u64 range.

account.pubkey: <a Phoenix Eternal Trader account on your fork>

overrides.label: Phoenix BTC direct mark risk shock
